listing.name: Burnout 3: Takedown — sp00nznet Burnout3 (sp00nznet)
listing.summary: Research project. Upstream alpha: original Xbox game menus/races/modes including split-screen reportedly run. Software NV2A makes menus~14FPS and races2–4FPS; no profile saving; texture/movie defects. Not a Portcove test. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own originalXbox Burnout3 Takedown disc ISO; extracted default.xbe beside Data/Tracks/ovid and other disc files. Exact retail revision/hash not established in retained README.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Windows Burnout3-Installer-windows-x64.exe or Setup.cmd imports own ISO, fetches xboxrecomp toolkit pinned afeb69f, generates C and compiles locally with VS2022/CMake/Python3.10+/capstone/Git. First generation/build roughly1–2hours; setup can provision missing tools.
